Standing in front of the rental car
parked 
by the school gate,
I pull out the special 
tickets.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's head out! Off to our hot 
springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Motion sickness pills, check! Navigation 
app, check! Passenger Tsuyoshi, ready to 
roll!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, hopping into the passenger 
seat!

Ah! Are you getting on already?

text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, hurry up, hurry up, Trainer~!
choice_data_list: Ah! You're boarding already?!
Ah! Are you getting on already?

text_block_list.text:
And so, with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi in the 
passenger seat, I drove off toward our 
destination.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna play music in the car,
it has 
to keep me awake~ Which song should I 
start with... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start with this! Let's get 
this trip off to a bright and auspicious 
start!
choice_data_list: Oh, this is a nice song.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I've surveyed Spe-chan 
and the others,
so I've got over 200 songs 
ready."
choice_data_list: Oh, that's a nice song.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're the one driving,
Trainer-san! I can 
go along with whatever your hobbies are!
choice_data_list: 200 songs! You really came prepared!
200 songs! You really came prepared!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, changing lanes next? Sounds like it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you take a detour. My 
throat was so dry...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I also grabbed some tea and gum for you, 
Trainer. I'll hand them to you once we're 
in the car.
choice_data_list: Huh, you bought it for me!? Let me...
Huh. You bought it for me!? Let me...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
At least let me treat you to this much~ 
You've taken care of me dozens of times 
more than this, after all.

text_block_list.text:
By the way, quite a few famous Umamusume 
seem to frequent our destination's hot 
spring, huh.

text_block_list.text:
"I heard from a senior Trainer that the 
hot spring has great benefits. It's the 
perfect place to soothe the fatigue she 
built up from running non-stop these past 
three years!"
choice_data_list: It's a popular resort destination ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Did you look it up too, Trainer~? All the 
great spots where we're going!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's one of the best parts of
traveling, 
after all! Just thinking about what we'll 
do once we arrive gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wahyaa! What a great view!! Awesome!
I can 
see so far into the distance—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I shouldn't be distracting 
Trainer-san while they're driving, right?!

Ahaha, it's enough for me as long ...

text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! I'll record a video on my 
smartphone! Let's watch it together 
later!"

Ahaha, as long as you enjoy the vi...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived! Trainer, thank you so much 
for driving!
choice_data_list: You too, Tsuyoshi! Thanks for all ...

text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's really not that much~. 
...Fufu.

text_block_list.text:
Now then,
Trainer-san! Since we've arrived 
at the inn, shall we~?
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and enjoy the ...

choice_data_list: Let's take our time and enjoy the ...

text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.text:
Fuhehe~... I'm still feeling all warm and 
fuzzy~...

That bath really warmed us to the ...

text_block_list.text: Yes~. That is precisely why~.

That water warmed us right to the ...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Staying hydrated is important for you
too, 
Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Consider this my treat, too.
choice_data_list: Now, now, I'll pay properly.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~?
choice_data_list: Hey now, I'll pay properly.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Over here, over here~.

"Even after soaking in the hot springs
and 
having dinner, our trip with Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi was far from over."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the onsen manju here is a 
famous specialty! They're individually 
wrapped, so they make the perfect 
souvenir.
choice_data_list: Oh, really! Maybe I'll buy some to...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: By all means! I think that sounds great!

And so, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi even worried 
about souvenir arrangements on my end. 
But...

You know you can go rest in your o...

text_block_list.text:
This schedule was originally made to take 
care of Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. I don't want 
to exhaust her too much.

You can head to your room and rest...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. I mean, this is a trip, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure you have fun and feel 
glad you came along with me too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And that'll make you want to keep me as 
your trainee forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if they enjoy today, ...it 
might not do much to build up that 
momentum.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But didn't I show great intuition and 
efficiency today? Wasn't I super 
dependable?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even when juniors join us from now on, I 
feel like I'll be able to guide them 
crisply as a senior!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi will always be an 
Umamusume who comes to your aid whenever 
you're in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you lose your way in the dark, 
I'll be the one to light up your path!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi will always continue 
to be a horse girl you can be proud of, 
Trainer!"
choice_data_list: No, because you've already been an...

text_block_list.text: ...Reeeally?
choice_data_list: No, you've already been my pride a...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Yeah, really.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of time left! I'm 
going to entertain you right until the 
very end, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Huh!? Weren't you convinced!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I-did-nooot-!!
choice_data_list: Huh!? Didn't you agree!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
More and more! Because I want to be the 
best Umamusume ever for my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe......... That's why, always.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Please stay by my side until the very 
end.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi...
